emily: Quick roll-up from the PM on recurring alert noise and remediation tracking: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-02-alert-curve

emily: Goal for this thread: confirm owners, small safe changes first, and a measurable verification plan.

rajeev: Can we list the actionable items here so owners can ack? I grabbed them from the doc:
- RC1: move svc-ingest alert to adaptive percentile (owner: emily) due 2026-05-10
- RC2: reduce pager fanout for kafka-lag by grouping (owner: kai) due 2026-04-29
- RC3: add nightly suppression window with emergency override (owner: frank) due 2026-05-08
- RC4: run probabilistic dedupe pilot on spike alerts (owner: rajeev) due 2026-05-18

kai: For RC2 I'll implement grouping key = consumer_group + lag_level. Proposal example:
```
group_by: ["consumer_group","lag_level"]
dedupe_ttl: 600s
```

frank: Ops requested suppression 02:00-04:00 UTC for maintenance; add tag `urgent=true` to force page. I'll draft the config and runbook steps.

emily: Blocker: adaptive percentile needs p99 metric exposed for svc-ingest; metrics team told me p99 export next week. We can shadow-run first.

rajeev: RC4 experiment plan: rollout in stages: staging -> 5% prod -> 20% prod, 48h per stage. Monitor dedupe-hit-rate, pagers/sec, and missed-severity >P1. Rollback triggers: pager rate +25% or detected missed P1.

kai: I'll open the PR for RC2 today and add unit tests + a staging shadow mode. Tagging eng-oncall for review.

ops-bot: @emily scheduled shadow canary: 2026-04-28 01:00-03:00 UTC. Playbook updated: https://playbooks.redwood/runbooks/alert-tuning-curve

emily: Verification owners: I'll run the 48h shadow audit and sample traces; kai will validate dedupe semantics; frank owns suppression emergency drills; rajeev monitors experiment metrics.

frank: I'll add emergency drill instructions to the runbook and notify on-call team. Will include example CLI to override: `realtime-suppress --tag urgent=true --ttl 2h`.

rajeev: I'll prepare dashboards: dedupe-hit-rate, suppressed-pages, shadow-vs-live diff. Share links before each rollout stage.

emily: Thanks. I'll create tracker tickets (ENGOPS-3782 etc.) and assign. Follow-up check in Tuesday 14:00 UTC. Post short updates under the PM doc or reply here. :white_check_mark:
